svg.title: 수채화 양치식물 · 2026 · ottuck
svg.desc: One leaf per date. Daily shades use GitHub contributionLevel. Larger leaves summarize a Sunday-based week using mean contribution counts. Future dates are faint. github data as of 2026-10-10.
svg.text: 365 DAILY LEAVES · 53 WEEKLY SUMMARIES · 73 ACTIVE DAYS
